1. 1907 draft scheme. When there is a question as to the interpretation of a Convention to which Powers other than those in dispute are parties, each of the Powers is entitled to intervene in the case (art. 22 cf. art. 84 of the Convention for the Pacific Settlement of International Conflicts).
2. Five Neutral Powers. Whenever a dispute submitted to the Court affects the interests of a third state, the latter may intervene in the case. (art. 48)
3. Interparliamentary Union. Same as 1907 draft. (art. 15)
4. International Law Union. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
5. Denmark. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
6. Norway. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
7. Netherlands. When there is a question as to the interpretation of a Convention to which Powers other than those in dispute are parties, each of these Powers is entitled to intervene in the case. (art. 49)
8. Sweden. When the dispute bears reference to an international convention or otherwise touches the interests of a third state, such state has the right to intervene in the dispute. (art. 21)
9. Switzerland. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
